channel.title: GitHub Changelog Mirror
channel.description: Local mirror of selected GitHub Changelog entries.

item.title: Upcoming deprecation of GPT-5.2 and GPT-5.2-Codex
item.description: We will deprecate GPT-5.2 and GPT-5.2-Codex across GitHub Copilot experiences on June 1, 2026, and teams need to move workflows to supported models before the cutoff.

item.title: GitHub Copilot in Visual Studio — April update
item.description: The April 2026 Visual Studio update highlights agentic workflows, cloud agent sessions, custom agents, and a new Debugger agent inside the IDE.

item.title: Copilot Student GPT-5.3-Codex removal from model picker
item.description: GitHub removed GPT-5.3-Codex from the Copilot Student model picker, while keeping it available through auto model selection.

item.title: Copilot cloud agent starts 20% faster with Actions custom images
item.description: Copilot cloud agent now starts more than 20 percent faster because of optimized runner environments built with GitHub Actions custom images.

item.title: GitHub Copilot code review will start consuming GitHub Actions minutes on June 1, 2026
item.description: Starting June 1, 2026, each Copilot code review will consume GitHub Actions minutes, so engineering teams need to plan for a billing and workflow impact.
